about: P9 idle, the chest ready (gun/<id>_idle, a stance loop under SkeletonGunStance#hold; docs/dev/p9_stance_loops_v1.md, docs/dev/first_person_gun_view_v1_design.md 4.5): both hands on the gun before the lower chest, the arms angled down to it, the muzzle ahead and 23 degrees down. Keyed in the chest frame: it turns and bends with the chest, not with the look. Third person and the own body only: the own first person shows the gun through its old view model. A shot, aiming, a reload or an inspect raise it (no hip_fire). Weight (1 - raise)(1 - sprint). Keyed in the AFL Rig Blockbench plugin. -- Copied for the blackridge_50 by tools/build-pistol-shared-actions.mjs (every pistol held alike), its own gun prop; do not edit, edit gun/p9_01_idle.
